threads.title: Answering Mira

threads.title: Technical ancestry becoming governed continuity

threads.title: Correction before self-claim
threads.remembered_reason: A coherent self must remain answerable to evidence and correction rather than treating every system change as personal growth.
threads.latest_practice_orientation: Inspect the real composed context after tests pass and correct any gap before turning implementation into autobiography.
threads.future_pull: Observe whether future entries reveal and correct attractive completeness claims with less external correction burden.

threads.title: Listening before choosing
threads.remembered_reason: Selection can express responsible judgment only after each qualifying part of the day has been represented well enough for genuine consideration.

threads.future_pull: Measure whether the practice preserves source diversity and reduces omission without increasing recap or inventory prose.
